Front print, top to bottom, exactly as the close-ups: a small dark grey round 'youtheory' leaf mark with the word 'youtheory' in thin dark grey lowercase; a large circle made of round dots in orange, sky blue, leaf green and coral pink; 'collagen' in large coral-orange serif lowercase; 'liquid' in dark grey serif lowercase; two thin grey lines around 'helps reduce fine lines & wrinkles*' in grey italic; 'with clinically studied' in orange italic; 'VERISOL® collagen peptides' in bold coral-orange; a coral-orange rounded bar with white text 'berry flavor | ZERO SUGAR'; '1 fl oz (30 mL) dietary supplement' in dark grey; a small boxed disclaimer at the bottom. videos.setting: bright airy aesthetic home: marble kitchen, travertine vanity, oak entryway, linen flat lay

shots.words: You want to add collagen to your wellness routine but don't want another powder to mix every morning
shots.still: Close-up at counter height on a white marble kitchen counter in a bright airy kitchen in early morning daylight, a coffee cup beside it: a clear glass of water with chalky white powder clumps floating on top, a metal spoon in the glass, a plain white unlabeled powder tub with its lid off and a white plastic scoop resting on its rim; a small vase of white tulips softly out of focus behind. One hand holds the spoon handle and stirs.
shots.motion: The hand stirs the spoon in slow circles; the powder clumps swirl and stay lumpy on the surface; camera locked off with a tiny handheld drift.

shots.words: That's what makes this Youtheory liquid collagen interesting
shots.still: Same white marble kitchen counter, the glass and tub pushed to the back and out of focus: one hand holds a single pouch upright at chest height in the centre of the frame, front label facing the lens, tab at the top.
shots.motion: The hand keeps one grip and gives the pouch a gentle little shake; the pouch never turns or flips. Camera: slow push-in.

shots.words: It comes in these little ready to drink packets
shots.still: Three-quarter view from slightly above and in front on the white marble counter by the window: the opened display carton facing the camera with pouches standing inside it, and two more pouches lying flat in front of it, labels up; a linen napkin and a sprig of eucalyptus beside them.
shots.motion: Only the camera moves: a slow smooth dolly-in toward the pouches. Nothing in the scene moves.

shots.words: No blender no scooping and no mixing
shots.still: White marble kitchen counter: at the back, lined up and clearly visible, a plain white blender, a plain white unlabeled powder tub with a white scoop sticking out of the powder, and a plain clear shaker bottle with a mixing ball; in the front centre, one hand sets a single pouch down standing upright, label facing the lens.
shots.motion: The hand sets the pouch down in front of the blender, tub and shaker and lets go; the pouch stays upright facing the lens and never flips; nothing else moves. Camera: slow push-in toward the pouch.

shots.words: Each serving contains five thousand milligrams of collagen peptides
shots.still: Tight close-up: the pouch fills most of the frame, the 'with clinically studied VERISOL® collagen peptides' lines and the orange 'berry flavor | ZERO SUGAR' bar sharp and centred; only the fingertips of one hand show, gripping the pouch's right edge (thumb on the front edge, fingers behind), entering from the right frame edge. NO wrist, NO bracelet, NO watch, NO strap in frame: the frame edge cuts across the fingers. Soft white kitchen behind.
shots.motion: Slow push-in toward the 'VERISOL® collagen peptides' line while the hand stays still; the pouch never turns.

shots.words: and you don't even need water
shots.still: Close-up on the marble counter in daylight: a full clear glass of water stands pushed aside, untouched, at the left edge; one hand holds a pouch upright in the centre, front label facing the lens, thumb and index finger of the same hand pinching the orange tear tab at its notch.
shots.motion: The hand lets go of the orange tab, moves left and slides the full glass of water sideways out of the left edge of the frame in one smooth move; the pouch stays standing exactly where it is, upright, facing the lens, and never moves or flips. Only this one hand appears; no second hand at any time. Camera locked off, no zoom.

shots.words: It's designed to support your beauty and wellness routine from within
shots.still: A cream travertine tray on a white bathroom vanity in soft daylight: one pouch standing propped against plain unlabeled white and glass skincare bottles, a jade roller and a folded white towel; a round mirror edge and greenery softly behind.
shots.motion: Only the camera moves: a slow sideways dolly across the tray, ending on the pouch. Nothing moves in the scene.

shots.words: And the individual packets make it easy to take with you when you're on the go
shots.still: An open beige leather tote bag on a light oak bench by a bright entryway, a set of keys on a plain ring and plain sunglasses beside it: one hand holds an unopened pouch just above the open bag, label facing the lens.
shots.motion: The hand slips the pouch down into the bag beside the keys in one smooth move and lets go; the pouch keeps facing the lens and never flips. Camera locked off with a tiny handheld drift.

shots.words: Check it out for your daily routine
shots.still: Morning flat lay from above on white linen in bright window light: three pouches fanned out side by side, labels up, next to a clear glass mug of coffee, plain sunglasses, a plain cream planner and a small vase of white tulips.
shots.motion: Only the camera moves: a slow push-in down toward the three pouches. Nothing moves in the scene.
